title: Architecture decision reference (consumer view)
description: One entry of machine-handoff/architecture.json `decisions`, as a downstream engineering system reads it when a task relies on the decision. The planner's full shape is fixed by schemas/architecture-decision.schema.json; other fields are tolerated. Only an accepted decision governs work.

active.description: True only for an accepted decision.

constraints.description: Constraints the decision places on downstream work, in reviewable language.
